fusions.name: Sewing Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stingers at once, spread apart. Each stinger deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Left In
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A weapon strike that deals 8 damage and leaves a barb on a strand in the wound: the target is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and moves 20% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Trailing Hive
fusions.desc: After a 0.3 second cast, looses a swarm for 12 seconds. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Nectar Run
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and draw back to you, healing you for 5% of your maximum health per strand. Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.
